job.text: What share of all donations did the two largest donors give together?

insight.important: Mrs. Smith and Mrs. Jones gave almost half of all donations

title.text: Mrs. Smith and Mrs. Jones Gave Almost Half of All Donations

source.shows: a subtotal stated as a fraction: a pie, the two parts next to each other from 12 o'clock in the strong shades of their colours and the others paled, as the book emphasises a subtotal (G1.37, G7.30; D-9: the others pale only for a subtotal)
